blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte will receive no special arrangements for his expected appearance as a witness in the impeachment trial of his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, according to Senate Impeachment Court spokesperson Reginald Tongol. “There are no special arrangements like that because the holding room reserved by the Senate for the vice president is always ready. And if the good Mayor Duterte wants to use that holding room of her sister, he can stay there,” Tongol said in an interview with radio dzBB on Sunday.
